meta.scope: City/county-level financial facts for U.S. localities. Sourced from official city/state publications (2026). This is a curated seed; expanding coverage is ongoing data-ops work.
meta.ymyl: Every figure is sourced from an official government publication. Rates change on their scheduled dates — always re-confirm with the cited source before relying on a number.

seattle.minWageNote: Applies to all employers regardless of size (Seattle Minimum Wage Ordinance). WA state floor is $17.13.

cityIncomeTax.note: NYC residents pay a city income tax of 3.078%–3.876% on top of NY state tax (4%–10.9%). Commuters who live outside NYC do NOT pay it. Yonkers residents pay a 16.75% surcharge on NY state tax instead.
cityIncomeTax.source: NYC Dept. of Finance / NYS Taxation & Finance

cityIncomeTax.note: Yonkers residents pay a 16.75% surcharge on their NYS income tax liability (not on gross income).
Philadelphia Wage/Earnings Tax (3.735% resident, 3.425% non-resident as of Jul 1 2026). PA state flat income tax 3.07% applies on top for residents.
Pittsburgh resident earned income tax ~3.0% (PA municipal EIT). PA state 3.07% applies on top.
Scranton resident earned income tax ~3.4% (PA municipal EIT).
Reading resident earned income tax ~2.0% (PA municipal EIT).
Allentown resident earned income tax ~1.5% (PA municipal EIT).
Erie resident earned income tax ~1.5% (PA municipal EIT).

CA.note: Property tax is due in two installments: 1st due Nov 1 (delinquent Dec 10); 2nd due Feb 1 (delinquent Apr 10). Rate ~1% + local bonds.

TX.note: Most Texas counties: tax bills mailed Oct, due Jan 31 (penalty after Feb 1). Dates vary by county appraisal district.

NY.note: NYS property tax varies by county; school-tax and county-tax installments commonly due in winter/summer. Check your county treasurer.

FL.note: Florida: most counties bill Nov 1 with discounts for early payment; becomes delinquent Apr 1.

IL.note: Illinois: most counties due Jun 1 and Sep 1. Check your county collector.
